verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs describe event triggers: on email arrival it can draft replies, add team comments, organize threads into todos, and connect to other apps. Its custom AI filters automatically label, star and archive mail using rules written in plain English. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of trigger configuration and the range of supported events beyond incoming email, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the triggers and filters work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.
Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
